purpose: Review first mock eligible legacy core flashcard prompts for compound questions and excessive answer demands. Complements answer correctness and full AQA bullet audit.
scope: Original 2,373 first mock core cards: Physics AS, taught Chemistry and first Maths Year 1 Pure
rules: Count multiple question marks, second question introductions, two imperative tasks and longer model explanations
Rank candidate cards for human review; no automatic rewriting because long calculations can be appropriate
Do not certify full AQA coverage from a size scan
